result.topic_en: A heavily corrected draft outline of a second section on Abelian functions, discussing the general solution of the Jacobi inversion problem via theta-type series, the special case of hyperelliptic integrals treated by Weierstrass, and the counting of independent moduli (3p-3 arbitrary among p(p+1)/2 quantities a with (p-2)(p-3)/2 relations).

items.english: In the second section the Jacobi inversion problem is solved for an arbitrary system of finite integrals of equally branched algebraic functions.
